Fix an infinite loop error for `Layout/FirstParameterIndentation` with `Layout/ParameterAlignment` when `EnforcedStyle: with_fixed_indentation` is configured.
Fix a false positive for `Layout/HashAlignment` when using `EnforcedHashRocketStyle: table` and a hash key spans multiple lines.
Fix an error for `Layout/HashAlignment` when a hash value starts on the line below its key.
Fix an error for `Layout/HashAlignment` when the first pair of a hash omits its value, and an incorrect autocorrection when a later pair does.
Fix an infinite loop between `Layout/ArgumentAlignment` and `Layout/HashAlignment` with separator style.
Fix `Layout/IndentationWidth` false positive for chained method blocks when `EnforcedStyleAlignWith` is `start_of_line`.
Fix `Layout/IndentationWidth` to indent block bodies relative to the method selector for trailing-dot multi-line method chains when `EnforcedStyleAlignWith` is `relative_to_receiver`.
Fix a false negative for `Layout/IndentationWidth` when the body of a multiline grouped expression in parentheses is not indented.
Support autocorrection for tab indentation in `Layout/IndentationWidth` and `Style/ClassAndModuleChildren`.
Fix an error for `Layout/IndentationWidth` on under-indented code with tab indentation.
Add new `AllowYARDCommentBlockSeparator` option to `Layout/LeadingCommentSpace`.
Fix an error in `Layout/LineLength` when `SplitStrings` option is enabled and `__FILE__` is used.
Fix an infinite loop and file corruption for `Layout/LineLength` with `SplitStrings` when an over-long string is indented under a multi-line parent.
Fix `Layout/LineLength` autocorrection for endless methods with block bodies.
Improve `Layout/LineLength` performance on files with large collection literals.

Make `Style/IfUnlessModifier`, `Style/WhileUntilModifier`, `Style/GuardClause`, and other modifier cops respect `Layout/LineLength` exemptions (allowed patterns, cop directives, allowed URIs) when checking whether the modifier form fits on one line.
Fix false negatives in `Layout/LineLength` when a constant path like `Http::UploadedFile` matches `URISchemes` case-insensitively.
Fix a regression in RuboCop 1.89 where the modifier cops could produce lines longer than `Layout/LineLength` `Max` when exemptions like `AllowedPatterns` matched the result.
Fix an infinite loop for `Layout/LineLength` with `SplitStrings: true` when the split point lands on a trailing space.
Fix an infinite loop error for `Style/EndlessMethod` when an indented method definition would exceed `Layout/LineLength` once made endless.
Fix a false negative in `Layout/MultilineAssignmentLayout` when using `numblock` or `itblock` with `SupportedTypes: ['block']`.
Recognize block on different line from left side of multi-line assignment in `Layout/MultilineAssignmentLayout`.
Fix an infinite loop error for `Layout/FirstParameterIndentation` with `Layout/ParameterAlignment` when `EnforcedStyle: with_fixed_indentation` is configured.

Set the community-preferred `EnforcedStyle` of `Style/StringLiterals`, `Style/StringLiteralsInInterpolation`, `Layout/CaseIndentation`, `Layout/EndAlignment`, `Layout/MultilineMethodCallIndentation`, `Layout/MultilineOperationIndentation`, `Layout/FirstHashElementIndentation`, `Layout/FirstArrayElementIndentation`, `Layout/ParameterAlignment`, `Layout/ArgumentAlignment`, `Style/EmptyMethod`, `Style/Alias`, `Style/RescueStandardError` and `Style/TernaryParentheses` under `Preview`, ahead of them becoming the defaults in RuboCop 2.0.

Make `Layout/SpaceAroundOperators` aware of endless method definitions.
Fix an infinite loop between `Layout/ExtraSpacing` with `ForceEqualSignAlignment` and `Layout/SpaceAroundOperators`.
Fix an infinite loop between `Layout/SpaceAroundOperators` and `Layout/ExtraSpacing` with `ForceEqualSignAlignment: true` for aligned operator assignments.

Change `AllowForAlignment` to no longer treat a same-indentation line beyond the enclosing block as an alignment anchor for `Layout/ExtraSpacing`, `Layout/SpaceAroundOperators`, and `Layout/SpaceBeforeFirstArg`.
Fix an infinite loop between `Layout/SpaceAroundBlockParameters` and `Layout/SpaceInsideParens` when the two cops enforce conflicting styles for a lambda's parameter parentheses.
Fix a false negative for `Lint/AmbiguousAssignment` when using attribute or index assignment.
Extend `Lint/AmbiguousBlockAssociation` to detect `do...end` blocks likely intended for enumerable methods in arguments.

Fix an incorrect autocorrect for `Lint/RedundantCopDisableDirective` and `Lint/RedundantCopEnableDirective` when a cop name in the directive is a prefix of another cop name in the same directive (e.g. `Lint/AmbiguousOperator` and `Lint/AmbiguousOperatorPrecedence`).

Fix an incorrect autocorrect for `Lint/RedundantCopDisableDirective` and `Lint/RedundantCopEnableDirective` when a cop name in the directive is a prefix of another cop name in the same directive (e.g. `Lint/AmbiguousOperator` and `Lint/AmbiguousOperatorPrecedence`).
Fix an infinite loop between `Lint/AssignmentInCondition` and `Style/RedundantParentheses` when an assignment is a statement of a multi-statement `begin` in a condition.
Fix an infinite loop error for `Lint/AssignmentInCondition` when an assignment is inside `defined?`.
Fix an infinite loop between `Style/ParenthesesAroundCondition` with `AllowSafeAssignment: false` and `Lint/AssignmentInCondition`.
Detect constant reassignment after class/module definition in `Lint/ConstantReassignment`.
Add optional Rubydex integration via `AllCops/UseProjectIndex` to enable cross-file detection in `Lint/ConstantReassignment` (experimental).
Fix an error for `Lint/ConstantReassignment` when a built-in constant name is assigned and `UseProjectIndex` is enabled.
Fix false positives in `Lint/ConstantReassignment` when a constant is assigned in compact-style namespaces (e.g. `module A::B`).
Change `Lint/ConstantResolution` to report only genuinely ambiguous constants when `UseProjectIndex` is enabled.
Make `Lint/CopDirectiveSyntax` catch keyword typos and unknown cop names.
Fix `Lint/CopDirectiveSyntax` falsely reporting multiple directives when valid reason text mentions another directive.
Enable `Lint/CopDirectiveSyntax` by default, so directives that silently disable nothing are reported.
Remove `Style/DoubleCopDisableDirective`, superseded by `Lint/CopDirectiveSyntax`, which now reports and corrects more than one directive on a line.
Improve `Lint/Debugger` performance on code without debugger calls.
Fix false negatives for `Lint/DuplicateMethods` when duplicate methods are defined in anonymous classes and modules not assigned to a constant.
Fix a false positive for `Lint/DuplicateMethods` when modules blocks are passed as method arguments.
Fix a false positive for `Lint/DuplicateMethods` when the same method is defined in different anonymous module blocks passed to a no-receiver call (e.g. `stub_const`).
Fix false positives in `Lint/DuplicateMethods` when the same method is defined in anonymous module blocks passed to different receivers.
Fix `Lint/DuplicateMethods` false positives for anonymous classes in constant assignments and method return values.
Fix `Lint/DuplicateMethods` false positives with anonymous classes inside blocks (e.g. RSpec `let`, `describe`).
Add `DelegatingMethods` option to `Lint/DuplicateMethods` to register custom `delegate`-shaped methods.

Fix false positives in `Lint/DuplicateMethods` for anonymous classes (`Class.new`) passed as arguments to the same named-receiver method call (e.g. `T.cast`). Each `Class.new` block is an independent class, so methods defined in different blocks should not be treated as duplicates.
Change `Lint/DuplicateMethods` to detect duplicates across files when `UseProjectIndex` is enabled.
Make `Lint/DuplicateMethods` honor `silence_redefinition_of_method` and `redefine_method` as intentional redefinitions.
Add `AllowedCrossFilePaths` option to `Lint/DuplicateMethods` to skip cross-file duplicates in configured paths.
Fix false positives in `Lint/DuplicateMethods` for singleton methods in separate anonymous classes.

Fix false positives in `Lint/EnsureReturn` and `Lint/NoReturnInBeginEndBlocks` for `return` inside a nested method definition or lambda.
Fix an incorrect autocorrect for `Lint/ErbNewArguments` when a keyword argument follows the `safe_level` argument.
Fix a false positive for `Lint/FloatComparison` when comparing against a parenthesized zero or `nil`.
Fix a false positive for `Lint/IncompatibleIoSelectWithFiberScheduler` when the single array argument element is a splat.
Fix false negatives for `Lint/InheritException` when `Exception` is inherited indirectly through a project class (`UseProjectIndex`).
Fix autocorrect producing `SyntaxError` in `Lint/InterpolationCheck` when single quoted string contains double quotes with invalid interpolation.
Fix a false negative for `Lint/InterpolationCheck` when interpolation appears in a multiline single-quoted string.
Fix an incorrect autocorrect for `Lint/LambdaWithoutLiteralBlock` that dropped safe navigation from the block argument.
Fix an error for `Lint/LiteralAsCondition` when a literal condition has an empty branch.
Fix an incorrect autocorrect for `Lint/LiteralAsCondition` when the other operand is a parenthesized `return`.
Fix a false positive for `Lint/LiteralAssignmentInCondition` when a literal is assigned inside a block in the condition.
Fix incorrect autocorrects for `Lint/LiteralInInterpolation` with embedded quotes and escaped interpolation text.
Fix an incorrect autocorrect for `Lint/LiteralInInterpolation` when interpolated hashes contain symbols that require quoted syntax, such as `:'foo-bar'`.
Fix an incorrect autocorrect for `Lint/LiteralInInterpolation`.
Fix false positive for `Lint/MissingCopEnableDirective` when `# rubocop:disable` is wrapped in a `# rubocop:push` / `# rubocop:pop` block.

Rename inconsistently named cop parameters to follow RuboCop's conventions (the old names are deprecated but still work): `Bundler/GemComment`'s `IgnoredGems` to `AllowedGems`, `Lint/NumberConversion`'s `IgnoredClasses` to `AllowedClasses`, `Lint/MissingCopEnableDirective`'s `MaximumRangeSize` to `MaxRangeSize`, `Metrics/CollectionLiteralLength`'s `LengthThreshold` to `Max`, and `Style/FetchEnvVar`'s `AllowedVars` to `AllowedVariables`.
Make `Lint/MissingCopEnableDirective` suggest `# rubocop:pop` instead of `# rubocop:enable` for an unclosed `# rubocop:push`.
Change `Lint/MissingSuper` to skip the constructor offense when the project index shows no ancestor defines `initialize` (`UseProjectIndex`).
Fix false positives in `Lint/EnsureReturn` and `Lint/NoReturnInBeginEndBlocks` for `return` inside a nested method definition or lambda.
Fix a false negative for `Lint/NonLocalExitFromIterator` when the iterator receiver uses safe navigation.
Stop autocorrecting `Lint/NumberConversion` offenses on safe navigation calls.

Rename inconsistently named cop parameters to follow RuboCop's conventions (the old names are deprecated but still work): `Bundler/GemComment`'s `IgnoredGems` to `AllowedGems`, `Lint/NumberConversion`'s `IgnoredClasses` to `AllowedClasses`, `Lint/MissingCopEnableDirective`'s `MaximumRangeSize` to `MaxRangeSize`, `Metrics/CollectionLiteralLength`'s `LengthThreshold` to `Max`, and `Style/FetchEnvVar`'s `AllowedVars` to `AllowedVariables`.
Fix an incorrect autocorrect for `Lint/NumericOperationWithConstantResult` when using safe navigation, as the result is `nil` when the receiver is `nil`.

Mark `Lint/NumericOperationWithConstantResult` autocorrect as unsafe because it drops the operands, discarding their side effects and silencing cases where the result is not actually constant (e.g. `x / x` raises when `x` is `0`).
Fix a false negative for `Lint/OrderedMagicComments` when an `encoding` magic comment is preceded by a magic comment other than `frozen_string_literal` (e.g. `shareable_constant_value`).
Recognize `warn_indent` as a magic comment. This fixes a false positive for `Layout/EmptyLineAfterMagicComment` and makes `Lint/OrderedMagicComments` and `Style/MagicCommentFormat` aware of it.
Fix a false negative for `Lint/OutOfRangeRegexpRef` when a preceding element access with a non-string literal argument (e.g. `hash[:key]`) discarded the tracked capture count.
Fix false positives in `Lint/ParenthesesAsGroupedExpression` when the first argument is a call-like expression with its own parentheses, such as `yield(...)`.
Fix an incorrect autocorrect for `Lint/ParenthesesAsGroupedExpression` when the parentheses contain `and`, `or`, `not`, or a modifier expression.
Fix a false positive for `Lint/RaiseException` when `raise Exception` is used inside a module nested within an allowed implicit namespace (e.g. `Gem`).

Fix an incorrect autocorrect for `Lint/RedundantCopDisableDirective` and `Lint/RedundantCopEnableDirective` when a cop name in the directive is a prefix of another cop name in the same directive (e.g. `Lint/AmbiguousOperator` and `Lint/AmbiguousOperatorPrecedence`).
Make `Lint/RedundantCopEnableDirective` flag `# rubocop:pop` directives without a matching `# rubocop:push`.
Fix `Lint/RedundantCopDisableDirective` and `Lint/RedundantCopEnableDirective` leaving a directive's `--` reason behind when removing the directive.
Fix a false positive for `Lint/RedundantDirGlobSort` when `sort` is given a comparator block or a block-pass argument, which is not redundant with the default sorting.
Fix false positive in `Lint/RedundantSafeNavigation` when using `&.respond_to?` with methods defined on `Object` (e.g., `:class`).
Make `Lint/RedundantSafeNavigation` aware of safe navigation in conditional true branch.
Fix false positive for `Lint/RedundantSafeNavigation` when chained safe navigation is used in a conditional expression with `InferNonNilReceiver` enabled.
Fix false positives in `Lint/RedundantSafeNavigation` when safe navigation appears in `rescue` or `ensure` bodies.
Fix false positives in `Lint/RedundantSafeNavigation` when safe navigation appears in the body of `unless`.

Fix false negatives for `Lint/RedundantSafeNavigation` with `&.respond_to?` on a guaranteed-instance receiver (e.g. `foo.to_s&.respond_to?(:class)`) and with `&.to_h` using a numbered-parameter or `it` block (e.g. `foo&.to_h { _1 } || {}`).
Fix false positives in `Lint/RedundantSafeNavigation` when `InferNonNilReceiver` is enabled and the receiver name is rebound by a nested block (`it` or a shadowed block parameter).
Fix a bad autocorrect for `Lint/RedundantSplatExpansion` when splatting an empty literal (e.g. `when *[]` or `rescue *[]`), which expanded to invalid or semantically different code.
Fix a false negative for `Lint/RedundantWithIndex` when the block takes no arguments (e.g. `ary.each_with_index { do_something }`).
Make `Lint/RedundantWithObject` autocorrect unsafe, since `each_with_object` returns the memo object while the corrected `each` returns the receiver.
Add autocorrection to `Lint/RefinementImportMethods` (replacing `include`/`prepend` with `import_methods`) and report that the functionality was removed (not just deprecated) on Ruby 3.2+.
Fix a bad autocorrect for `Lint/RegexpAsCondition` when the regexp literal is negated (e.g. `if !/foo/`), which inverted the condition.
Reword the `Lint/RequireRangeParentheses` offense message, which incorrectly called the flagged (finite) range "endless".
Fix false positives in `Lint/RequireRelativeSelfPath` when a non-`.rb` file uses `require_relative` with its own basename.

Fix false negatives for `Lint/RescueType` when rescuing from `true`, `false`, a rational literal (`1r`), or a complex literal (`1i`), all of which raise a `TypeError` at runtime.
Fix incorrect autocorrection in `Lint/SafeNavigationChain` when chaining a method call after safe navigation in the if branch of a ternary.
Fix a false negative for `Lint/SafeNavigationChain` when an ordinary method is chained after a parenthesized safe navigation call (e.g. `(x&.foo).bar`).
Mark `Lint/SafeNavigationChain` autocorrection as unsafe.
Mark `Lint/SafeNavigationConsistency` autocorrect as unsafe.
Fix a false negative for `Lint/SafeNavigationWithEmpty` when the receiver of `&.empty?` is a local variable, instance variable, constant, or other non-method-call expression.
Fix `Lint/ScriptPermission` to honor a cop-level `AutoCorrect: false` setting and to not crash on sources without a file on disk (e.g. unsaved editor buffers).
Fix false negatives for `Lint/SelfAssignment` with `||=` and `&&=` on constants, attributes, and hash keys (e.g. `Foo ||= Foo`, `foo.bar ||= foo.bar`, `hash['foo'] ||= hash['foo']`).
Fix a false negative for `Lint/SendWithMixinArgument` when `send`/`public_send`/`__send__` is called with no explicit receiver or with a `self` receiver (e.g. `send(:include, Bar)`).
Fix a false positive for `Lint/ShadowingOuterLocalVariable` when a block argument has the same name as a pattern variable from a different `in` branch of the same `case`.

Fix false negatives for `Lint/SharedMutableDefault` when a mutable default is combined with a `capacity:` keyword argument and given as an array or `Array.new`/`Hash.new` (e.g. `Hash.new([], capacity: 42)`).

Fix a false positive for `Lint/SuppressedExceptionInNumberConversion` when the numeric constructor already passes `exception: false` (e.g. `Integer(arg, exception: false) rescue nil`), which also produced an autocorrect with a duplicate `exception: false` keyword.
Fix a bad autocorrect for `Lint/SymbolConversion` when the receiver is an interpolated string containing an embedded double quote (e.g. `"foo#{bar}\"qux".to_sym`), which produced a syntax error.
Fix `Lint/Syntax` zero-length diagnostic range for syntax errors at EOF.

Fix a false negative for `Lint/ToEnumArguments` when more positional arguments are passed than the method accepts (e.g. `def m(x); to_enum(:m, x, extra); end`), which raises `ArgumentError` when the enumerator is used.

Fix a false negative for `Lint/ToEnumArguments` when a braced hash is passed to keyword parameters (e.g. `to_enum(:m, { required: required })`), which raises `ArgumentError` when the enumerator is used.
